definition: to get lost or vanish without warning
description: A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.

taps.phrase: to fly up behind the car

de.answer: Das Auto verschwindet die Straße hinunter.
de.question: Was macht das Auto?

es.answer: El coche está desapareciendo por la carretera.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el coche?
